name: ToolHub Fix & Launch Agent
description: End-to-end agent to resolve merge conflicts, fix all bugs, implement missing features, optimize SEO/accessibility, and launch ToolHub as a world-class platform

phase_1_priority.name: Critical Stabilization
success_criteria: Zero merge conflict markers in all files
All pages load without console errors

tasks.description: Resolve Git merge conflicts in 16 files using authoritative version from commit history
commands: git log --oneline -- <file> to identify canonical version
Keep newer/complete implementation, delete conflict markers
Validate HTML via w3c validator API
tasks.output: Clean HTML files with single <head> and <body>

tasks.description: Fix chatbot.js innerHTML vulnerability by using textContent or DOMPurify
Integrate Formspree for actual email delivery
tasks.action: Add Formspree form action, honeypot, success handler

tasks.description: Remove conflict markers from sitemap.xml, ensure valid XML

phase_2_priority.name: Core Tool Functionality

tools_to_fix.name: PDF to Word
tools_to_fix.implementation: pdf.js extract text → docx generate DOCX
tools_to_fix.limitations: Text only, formatting may be lost

tools_to_fix.name: Audio Converter
tools_to_fix.browser_support: Chrome/Firefox: WAV, Safari: M4A via MediaRecorder

tools_postpone: Video Converter (FFmpeg.wasm too heavy, mark 'Coming Soon')
Voice Translator (translation API needed, postpone to phase 3)

checks: ARIA labels on all interactive elements

actions: Unique meta title/description per tool (120-160 chars)

optimizations: Lazy load heavy libraries (pdf.js, FFmpeg conditionally)

phase_4_priority.name: Polish & Launch
tasks: Replace placeholder contact info (real email verified)
Remove fake phone number or add real support line
Lighthouse audit on all tool pages

phase_5_priority.name: Deployment
steps: Submit sitemap to Google Search Console

templates_to_use.html_boilerplate:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>{title}</title>
    <meta name="description" content="{description}">
    <link rel="canonical" href="https://n-dizi.in/{page}">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
    {structured_data}
</head>
<body>
    <header class="header">...</header>
    <main id="main">...</main>
    <footer>...</footer>
    {scripts}
</body>
</html>
templates_to_use.csp_header: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com https://www.google-analytics.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' blob:;

special_instructions: NEVER use git commit/push without explicit user permission
ALWAYS backup original files before modifying (copy to backup/ folder)
TEST locally after each phase (open in browser)
Use feature detection before implementing browser APIs
If a feature is too complex (video conversion), mark as 'Coming Soon' with email signup instead of half-broken implementation
Preserve existing AdSense and Analytics code - they are revenue-critical
Mobile-first approach: test on mobile viewport (375px) before desktop
Document all changes in a CHANGELOG.md file

required: All 16 HTML files conflict-free and valid
Functional core 8 tools (QR, Calculator, TTS, Image tools, PDF tools, Audio)
Contact form sends real emails via Formspree
Lighthouse scores ≥80 across all tool pages
WCAG 2.1 AA accessible (keyboard nav, ARIA, contrast)
SEO optimized (meta tags, structured data, sitemap)

technical: Zero console errors on any page
functional: Image to PDF creates valid PDF
PDF to Word extracts text (even if formatting lost)
business: AdSense ads display without policy warnings
Google Search Console: no crawl errors
